policies.platform_terms: This is a pre-release cafe loyalty service. A permanent verified account is required. Each cafe operates its own programme under the terms displayed when you join. Stamps and points are promotional units, not money or transferable stored value. Staff record eligible purchases; the service does not independently verify a POS sale. Rewards require server confirmation and staff fulfillment. Corrected purchases may reverse earned units, including after a reward was used. Joining does not enable marketing. You may leave and later rejoin the same cafe relationship; leaving preserves balance/history and disables marketing. Paused programmes and expired subscriptions block new earning and enrollment while preserving permitted earned-reward fulfillment and history. Suspended memberships cannot transact. Optional push and WhatsApp choices can be withdrawn in cafe preferences. WhatsApp follow-ups are manually reviewed and sent by the cafe. The business trial lasts 14 days from setup; the published plan is Rs 4,999 per month, with no automatic card charge. Paid activation requires verified payment. Cancellation takes effect at period end without grace; otherwise the default past-due grace is seven days. Pre-release functions that are unavailable are marked as such. Do not rely on unavailable functions for live business operations.
policies.privacy: The service processes verified account identity, display name, timezone, cafe memberships, consent evidence, loyalty activity, security/audit events, and optional notification-device information. Your birthday month/day is optional and remains private to your profile; cafe birthday participation is a separate choice. Each cafe can access only its own relationship and the contacts you explicitly share, subject to staff permissions. Your login email is not automatically shared with cafes. Optional phone numbers remain unverified until confirmed, and changing a number resets WhatsApp consent. Push tokens support notifications only after device verification. Supabase provides database, account and file services; Vercel hosts the web application; Google OAuth and Firebase support optional Google login and push. A separate server runs background processing. Marketing choices are independent of loyalty participation. Uploaded branding becomes public only after validation; payment evidence remains private. Leaving a cafe does not erase required transaction or audit history. Account deletion, data export, final retention periods and an operator support channel are release prerequisites; those controls are not yet available in this pre-release build. Use synthetic data for pre-release evaluation. This notice must be versioned again when those operating details are configured.
policies.push_marketing: Allow this cafe to send promotional push notifications to my verified device. Optional; I can withdraw this choice in cafe preferences without losing loyalty participation.
policies.push_reward: Allow this cafe to send reward-availability push updates to my verified device. Optional and separate from promotional push; I can turn it off in cafe preferences.
policies.push_birthday: Allow this cafe to send birthday-related push messages when I have also enabled its birthday inbox benefit. My birthday date is not displayed to cafe staff. Optional; I can withdraw this choice.
policies.inbox_birthday: Use my saved birthday month/day to evaluate this cafe's birthday benefit and place any qualifying benefit in my offer inbox. This does not enable push messages or disclose my birthday date to cafe staff. Optional; I can withdraw this choice.
policies.whatsapp_marketing: Allow this cafe to use my separately provided number for manually sent WhatsApp promotions. Staff review and send each message themselves. My number is initially unverified. Optional; I can withdraw this choice in cafe preferences, and changing my number resets it.
